modelRepairs.reason: A source-outline import created duplicate identities for concepts that are better represented as one multi-domain overlap space.
modelRepairs.semanticEffect: No external claim was deleted; source evidence was merged into the canonical overlap identity.

modelRepairs.reason: User clarified that Mathematics, Philosophy, Physics, Biology, Chemistry and Engineering were examples to start from, not an exhaustive list of foundational disciplines.
modelRepairs.semanticEffect: The six existing roots are reinterpreted as Seed Wave 0 probes. Foundational-domain census is OPEN and root count is explicitly UNKNOWN.

scope.seedPurpose: Schema/dogfood probes only; these six MUST NOT be interpreted as the complete foundational-domain set.

semantics.FOUNDATIONAL_CENSUS_OPEN: The foundational-domain inventory is intentionally incomplete; new domains may be added without treating prior absence as a contradiction.
semantics.NOT_REPRESENTED: Means absent from current reference sources/model, never DOES_NOT_EXIST.
semantics.OVERLAPS_DOMAIN: Reference synthesis indicating multi-domain placement; non-exclusive and non-authoritative.
semantics.REFERENCE_NODE: External coordinate-space concept only; does not mint Ordivon owner truth.
semantics.SEED_DISCIPLINE: A provisional reference root admitted for schema dogfood; seed membership does not imply exhaustiveness or privileged ontological fundamentality.
semantics.SUBCLASS_OF: Reserved for source evidence with explicit subclass semantics such as Wikidata P279; unused in v0 topic imports.
semantics.TOPICAL_MEMBER_OF: Weak topical placement from an outline/list; MUST NOT be interpreted as Wikidata P279/subclass-of.
